subject: Diagonal text on correlation matrix plot with facets

messages.author: 62b227645680b44d
messages.subject: Diagonal text on correlation matrix plot with facets
parts:
Hi,

I have different correlation matrices for Treatment and Subject
levels.
I would like to place labels on diagonal by geom_text(...)

qplot(X1,X2,data=toplot,geom='tile',fill=value,xlab='X axis',ylab='Y
axis')
+ facet_wrap(treatment ~ subject, ncol=3)
+ geom_text(aes(X1,X2,label=pval,data=toplot),size=1)
+ theme_bw()
+ scale_fill_gradientn(name='Rho',colours= c("red", "white", "blue"),
limits=c(1,-1))
+ scale_x_discrete(limits=rev(colnames(rcorr$P)))
+ scale_y_discrete(limits=colnames(rcorr$P))
+ geom_text(data=toids,aes(label=as.factor(value)),size=1);

However toids contains data that are at different subject&treatment
levels... and I get error
Error in dim(out) <- c(1, nrow(.$facet_levels)) :
dims [product 26] do not match the length of object [0]
In addition: Warning message:
In `[<-.factor`(`*tmp*`, rng, value = c(2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, :
invalid factor level, NAs generated

when I try

geom_text(data=ids,aes(label=value),size=1);

which is just a melted matrix for one subject it works, but all plots
in facets have the same text on diagonal.

Can someone help me, how to add text for each matrix in each facet
separately ?

1> dim(toids) # This is full matrix containing also information
about levels as toplot matrix does.
[1] 90 6
1> dim(ids) # This matrix contains only X1,X2 and value
[1] 6 3

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Diagonal text on correlation matrix plot with facets
parts:
Mateusz, 

I remember something similar a while back. I can't seem to find it though. From what I remember, you give your geom_text() a subset of your data. 

Since I don't have your dataset it's hard to type out the exact code and try it out so... 

You have facets that are by treatment and by subject. 

So you would have something like...

plot +
geom_text(data=subset(toids, treatment==1 & subject == "A", aes(x=X1, y=X2,label=as.factor(value)),  size=1)+
geom_text(data=subset(toids, treatment==2 & subject == "A", aes(x=X1, y=X2,label=as.factor(value)),  size=1)+
geom_text(data=subset(toids, treatment==3 & subject == "A", aes(x=X1, y=X2,label=as.factor(value)),  size=1)+
geom_text(data=subset(toids, treatment==1 & subject == "B", aes(x=X1, y=X2,label=as.factor(value)),  size=1)+
geom_text(data=subset(toids, treatment==1 & subject == "B", aes(x=X1, y=X2,label=as.factor(value)),  size=1)

and so on....

It's been a while though so I'm not sure if this works or not. Try it and let us know how it goes. 

B
